title: Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 2.5GHz 16-Core LGA 2011-3 Server Processor

items.h: Max Turbo Frequency: Up to 3.30 GHz

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 is a high-performance 16-core server processor designed for enterprise servers, virtualization platforms, and heavy multi-tasking workloads. Built on Intel’s 14nm Broadwell architecture, this CPU delivers powerful performance, high memory capacity support, and excellent reliability for data centers and professional environments.


Key Features


  • Base Clock Speed: 2.50 GHz
  • Max Turbo Frequency: Up to 3.30 GHz
  • Cores / Threads: 16 Cores / 32 Threads
  • Smart Cache: 40MB
  • Socket: LGA 2011-3 (FCLGA2011-3)
  • TDP: 120W
  • Architecture: 14nm Broadwell
  • Memory Support: DDR4 1600 / 1866 / 2133 / 2400 MHz
  • PCIe 3.0 Support
